task: GSM8K 8-shot chain-of-thought, base LM (no chat template)
metric: exact match of the extracted final number against the gold answer
answer_extraction: number after the last 'The answer is'; otherwise the last number in the output; commas, '$' and a trailing '.' removed; compared numerically

quality_floor.rule: pass (non-inferior) if the lower bound of the 95% paired bootstrap CI on accuracy(schedule) - accuracy(static_L) is >= -5.0 pp
quality_floor.not_established: point estimate >= -5.0 pp but CI lower bound < -5.0 pp
quality_floor.aligned_with: team-wide Week 1 quality gate (<= 5 pp loss vs Large, 95% paired bootstrap)

uncertainty: paired bootstrap 95% CI on the difference vs static_L (10,000 resamples, seed 6222; examples resampled individually since GSM8K questions are independent)
protocol: schedules and restrictions are chosen on dev; held-out is evaluated once, after selection
